description: Live Streaming with Gifts - Make LiveHost.tsx and LiveViewer.tsx functional using Firebase Firestore for stream data, gifts, and wallet operations. Currently they use Supabase for live_streams, live_chat, live_gifts, and livekit-token. Rewrite to use Firebase for data storage while keeping LiveKit integration for actual streaming (token generation can remain as a placeholder since it needs a backend). Add gift overlay animation and top gifters list.
steps: 1. Rewrite src/pages/LiveHost.tsx to use Firebase Firestore: (a) Replace supabase.from('live_streams').insert() with addDoc(collection(db, 'live_streams'), {...}) using schema {host_id, title, status: 'live', livekit_room, access_type, ticket_price_coins, allow_gifts, viewer_count: 0, total_gifts: 0, started_at: serverTimestamp()}. (b) The livekit-token invoke can stay as a placeholder (log a warning that LiveKit server token is not available in dev). For dev/demo purposes, show the camera preview locally without actually connecting to LiveKit (skip the room.connect if no token available). (c) Replace supabase.channel realtime subscriptions with Firestore onSnapshot listeners on live_chat and live_gifts sub-collections or filtered queries. (d) Replace supabase.from('gifts').select for catalog with a Firestore 'gift_catalog' collection query. (e) On stream end, updateDoc to set status: 'ended'.

2. Rewrite src/pages/LiveViewer.tsx to use Firebase Firestore: (a) Load stream from Firestore 'live_streams' collection by ID. (b) Replace supabase-based access checks with Firestore reads. (c) Gift sending: When viewer sends a gift, deduct coins from wallets/{viewerId}.total (increment negative), credit wallets/{hostId}.total (increment positive), write to 'live_gifts/{id}' with {stream_id, gift_id, sender_id, coins_total, created_at}. Also increment live_streams/{id}.total_gifts. (d) Use onSnapshot for real-time chat and gifts instead of supabase.channel. (e) LiveKit connection can remain as placeholder (show stream status without actual video if no token).

3. Create src/components/live/GiftOverlay.tsx: Animated gift overlay using framer-motion. Shows gift emoji flying across the screen when gifts arrive. AnimatePresence with scale+translate+fade animations. Accepts an array of recent gift events and renders them with staggered animations.

4. Create src/components/live/TopGifters.tsx: Shows top 3-5 gifters during a live stream. Queries live_gifts for the stream, aggregates by sender_id, shows avatar/username and total coins gifted. Updates in real-time via onSnapshot.
5. Update src/pages/LiveList.tsx to read from Firebase Firestore 'live_streams' collection where status == 'live' instead of Supabase.
6. Add test src/pages/LiveHost.test.tsx verifying the component renders the go-live form.
acceptance_criteria: LiveHost creates stream record in Firestore live_streams collection
LiveViewer reads stream from Firestore and shows viewer UI
Gift sending deducts from viewer wallet and credits host wallet in Firestore
Gift overlay animation shows when gifts are received
Top gifters list displays during live stream
LiveList reads active streams from Firestore
No Supabase imports remain in LiveHost, LiveViewer, or LiveList
findings: All three live pages (LiveHost, LiveViewer, LiveList) successfully rewritten from Supabase to Firebase Firestore. LiveKit token fetch uses VITE_LIVEKIT_TOKEN_URL env var with graceful fallback (local camera preview only). GiftOverlay and TopGifters components created. Build and all 33 tests pass.
